label: NICENE_CONSTANTINOPOLITAN_CREED_2: The recitation reproduced in the consulted Holy See English…
definition: The recitation reproduced in the consulted Holy See English Profession of Faith collection. It includes wording additional to the Greek 381 transcription, including God-from-God and Father-and-Son procession wording. This is a distinct textual formula; its additions are not substituted for the root’s Greek contents.
note: The linked source reading concerns proposal status. This scope definition neither endorses the additions nor asserts that Latin processio and Greek ekporeusis are interchangeable.
